paper.title: Sharp transition towards shared vocabularies in multi-agent systems

headline: Naming Game minimal (agent-based): 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; global consensus in 10/10 runs, mean 48958 interactions; peak total words ~10551 (N=1000) collapses to N

verdicts.gate: P1 global consensus reached in 100% of runs (one name held by all N)
P2 #distinct names peaks (>1) then collapses to exactly 1
P3 total vocabulary peaks (>N) then collapses to N (each agent ends with 1)

extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce the local->global consensus result (with its vocabulary peak) and would catch an artifact

citations: Baronchelli, A., Felici, M., Loreto, V., Caglioti, E. & Steels, L. (2006). Sharp transition towards shared vocabularies in multi-agent systems. J. Stat. Mech. (2006) P06014. doi:10.1088/1742-5468/2006/06/P06014.
Steels, L. (1995). A self-organizing spatial vocabulary. Artificial Life 2(3):319-332. doi:10.1162/artl.1995.2.3.319.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction
